records.text: Pressures over 2000 psig require hardened plungers and close-clearance rings. V-ring packing requires metal adapters.
When flushing is required, use V-ring packing.
Use Neo Duck packing for lime and diatomaceous-earth slurries with ceramic plungers and flush connections.
The source states that certain Milroyal D plunger sizes are available only with 25% carbon-filled PTFE packing; the printed fraction glyphs require manual verification.
